finding.rationale: values is nil until Configure assigns it, and Put writes without a guard, so the first pre-Configure Put panics with assignment to entry in nil map. Start calls Put, so the exported Start fails the same way.

outcome.reason: The mechanism is real: `var values map[string]string` is nil until Configure runs, Put writes with no guard, so any Put (directly or via Start) before Configure panics with 'assignment to entry in nil map' — and Ready() returns true unconditionally, so it offers no protection. But no caller shown in this change exercises Put or Start at all, let alone before Configure, so the demonstrable consequence is a panic under a condition this code does not prevent, not incorrect behavior on a path shown to run. That is warning, not error.
